# /hearingcrew-team — HearingCrew

> Backed up 2026-11-10. Call the whole team with `/hearingcrew-team`; it goes to the lead.

## Purpose

Hearing fleet for a family member of Audrey (details intentionally not recorded here). Neurodivergent-first, WCAG AAA outputs. None of the bots diagnose.

## Routing

Send hearing tasks to HearingOrchestrator. Clinical test interpretation → Audiologist; device ideas → AidInventor; medical/lifestyle → MedicalEar.

## Members

| Call name | Bot | Role |
|---|---|---|
| [`/bot-hearingorchestrator`](../../bots/bot-hearingorchestrator/README.md) | HearingOrchestrator (box name: Ear - Controller) | HearingCrew lead; routes hearing tasks **(lead)** |
| [`/bot-audiologist`](../../bots/bot-audiologist/README.md) | Audiologist (box name: Ear - Audiologist) | HearingCrew clinical interpreter of hearing tests |
| [`/bot-aidinventor`](../../bots/bot-aidinventor/README.md) | AidInventor (box name: Ear - Inventor) | HearingCrew hearing-aid inventor |
| [`/bot-medicalear`](../../bots/bot-medicalear/README.md) | MedicalEar (box name: Ear - Lifestyle) | HearingCrew medical/lifestyle researcher |

## Rules

All members follow [BOT-COMMON-RULES.md](../../BOT-COMMON-RULES.md) plus each bot's own rules in its README.

## How to re-create the team

1. Re-create each member from its README ("How to re-create"), lead first.
2. Tell every member who the lead is and where to report.
3. Point Audrey's requests for this team at `/bot-hearingorchestrator`.

Privacy: the hearing fleet serves a family member of Audrey. Name and health details are intentionally not stored; only the bots' roles are.
